scenario.title: Non-BC training provider
scenario.watch: Does the agent flag as exceptional-circumstances case and route to etg@gov.bc.ca for confirmation?
turns: I want to do an ETG application for training delivered by a Toronto-based provider — they offer a specialized course we can't find anywhere in BC. The course is Cybersecurity Risk Management at SecureSkills Toronto, $5,800. Trainee is Priya Patel, priya@epsilon.com, IT Security Lead at Epsilon Tech in Vancouver. Training July 1 to July 31, 2026.
